jobs.description:
Do you have experience in home cleaning and want to work within a company that gives the opportunity to grow and develop? Or are you in the beginning of your career and want to work in a company that offers high quality training and a safe employment? Apply to become one of our amazing home cleaners!
Freska - More than just a cleaning company 💙
Freska is one of the fastest growing companies with one goal in mind; to make Freska the best, most recommended workplace for service workers in Europe. In fact, our values; People first, Growth and Responsibility symbolize ways that we are working to make Freska a better workplace. Your day to day work, future goals and ambitions matter to us. Among other things we have developed a career path for our home cleaners as well as a support system to try to make everyday work life run as smoothly as possible. No matter if this is a job for you who wants to advance in your career, a safe employment or even start your first job here in Sweden, we are here for you!
We have come a long way to reach our goal and are always striving to find ways to improve. So far we have the possibility to offer our employees:
Contract with guaranteed hours from the start!
Possibility of bonus
Collective agreement
Health benefits
Paid travel time between customers
Career opportunities
Training and coaching in home cleaning
A tight-knit team with a team leader to support you in the daily work
Immediate support from the office during your working day
Unlimited amount of coffee and chats in the office
Steady schedule that locks seven days prior
Overtime compensated at 228 kr/hour, with monthly payouts and no time bank! 

About the job 👇
You will work in our customers most beloved place - their home. A home cleaning includes dusting, vacuuming and mopping. It is of great advantage if you have a sense of details. Your primary work tool will be our Freska Pro app where you will be able to see your schedule, customer information and general information about Freska.
With that being said, being a home cleaner also comes with some responsibility, therefore we are looking for someone who:
Speaks Swedish or English
Can work flexibly between our working hours 08.00-17.00.
Has a valid working permit
Has experience in cleaning, advantage but no requirement

So where do we go from here?
1. Apply!
2.Get an invite to an interview
3. Show us your cleaning skills
4. You’re hired!
5. Watch our digital onboarding
6. Come to the office for an onboarding
7. Go for training with your team leader
8. Start working, good luck!
Apply now!

Are you a driven Design Engineer with solid experience in Creo and a passion for smart engineering solutions? At ALTEN, we are always on the lookout for skilled and motivated engineers for future opportunities within the automotive industry. Whether your expertise lies in chassis, BIW, interior, exterior, thermal systems, or powertrain/engines, we want to connect with you. This is a proactive job posting aimed at professionals who are ready to explore their next career move.
Ready to take on new challenges and contribute to innovative automotive projects? Join us and drive your career forward!
What we offer
At ALTEN, we believe in nurturing your passion for technology and innovation. With diverse projects across various industries, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the world while advancing your own career. Our supportive leaders provide coaching and guidance to help you grow professionally. Additionally, you'll have access to personalized training opportunities through our ALTEN Academy and external courses, empowering you to reach your full potential.
We think it's important to have a balance between work and spare time, which is why we offer three extra days off per year. We have a collective agreement and offer benefits like pension, insurances and wellness grants.
Your profile
We are looking for a Design Engineer with several years of experience in the automotive industry, ideally with a strong background in Creo and hands-on experience designing components such as chassis, BIW, plastics, or related areas.
B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Engineering (Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical, or a related field)
Hands-on experience with Creo (Part modeling, assemblies, drawings)
Solid background in automotive mechanical design – e.g. chassis, BIW, exterior, interior, thermal, or powertrain/engines
Knowledge of manufacturing methods and material selection (e.g. plastics, metals, castings, sheet metal)
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams
Fluent in English, both spoken and written

Application
Please note, this is a proactive job advertisement intended to connect with talented professionals and does not refer to a specific assignment at this time. The opportunities are based in Gothenburg and offered as consultancy roles within ALTEN Sweden. We welcome your application!
About ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies with over 57,000 employees in nearly 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the value chain of the most prestigious companies in all sectors, such as Automotive, Defense, Energy & Environment, Industry, Public Services & Government and Life Sciences. In Sweden, we are about 1300 committed employees with 9 offices in 9 cities - from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
For five years in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden's most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen, an award for employers that offer unique career and development opportunities.

At Electrolux Professional Group we hire to meet needs beyond tomorrow!  
UNLOCK YOUR POTENTIAL  
At Electrolux Professional Group, we believe potential powers progress. We’re not searching for perfection—we’re looking for people with the right mindset. If you're curious, resilient, and ready to grow, you'll find the space to lead, innovate, and together with us Meet the needs beyond tomorrow. Read more about us here: https://www.electroluxprofessionalgroup.com/en/join-us/  
SOFTWARE TEST ENGENEER 
At Electrolux Professional, we're looking for three Software Test Engineers to join our R&D Lab in Ljungby and help shape the next generation of connected professional laundry solutions. 
In this role, you'll ensure that our software delivers the quality, reliability, and performance our customers depend on every day. Working closely with developers and cross-functional engineering teams, you'll play a key role in validating features, identifying improvements, and driving continuous quality throughout the development process. 
If you're passionate about testing, problem-solving, and turning complex technical challenges into robust solutions, then this is an opportunity where you can make a real impact! 
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING  
Perform software testing and validation activities. 
Test new software releases to ensure functionality, stability, and compliance with requirements. 
Develop, execute, and maintain test cases and test procedures. 
Identify, document, and track software defects. 
Collaborate closely with software developers to investigate and resolve issues. 
Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality is not affected by software changes. 
Support Software Quality Assurance (SQA) processes and continuous improvement activities. 
Report test results, issues, and validation status to the team. 

 
WHAT’S NEEDED FOR YOU TO THRIVE  
Good understanding of software testing methodologies and SQA principles. 
Experience in functional testing, regression testing, and defect management. 
Ability to analyze software requirements and translate them into test cases. 
Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
Familiarity with bug-tracking and test-management tools (e.g., Jira). 
Good communication skills and ability to work closely with software developers. 
Ability to work independently and as part of an international team. 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering or relevant field 
Fluent in English, both written and spoken. 

 
Advantage: 
Software skills (Python, C, C# or equivalent) 
Basic electronic skills (hardware) 
 

To be eligible for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in Sweden.  
OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLES   
Be Customer Obsessed. Build Trust. Be Bold. Act Sustainably. We’re building it every day — and we’d love your help.   
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU  
Trust, ownership, and the opportunity to grow! Be part of a company grounded in customer focus, sustainability leadership, innovation, and social impact.  
We aim to Meet Needs Beyond Tomorrow!  
Some of our benefits:  
Occupational pension plan  
Collective agreement  
Lunch benefits  
Massage at the office at discounted price  
Wellness allowance  
Beniflex (discounts on purchases)  
Parental leave benefits etc.

Job Scope 

Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function. 

The key responsibilities of manager quality control are to plan, manage and coordinate the activities of the Cell Analysis lab at Lyten Labs, including the chemical, mechanical and failure analysis teams. 

Purpose is to secure reliable, traceable pipeline and on-time quality control for incoming material, production samples and to support material development with analytical capability and instrumentation expertise. Lead the development of laboratories into one standardized and scalable organization. 

Key Responsibilities 

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to) 

Lead by example and safety-first principle 

Lead the quality control team members 

Plan, organize and review organization, competences, development and training of the lab 

Plan and align the resources and the demand across team members 

Ensure the lab works according to the scope of internal laboratory and the analytical scope and ownership matrix 

Ensure methods, SOP’s, risk assessments and work instructions are developed, implemented and reviewed according to the company rules and guidelines 

Ensure the laboratory utilities/equipment are maintained, calibrated and safe to use, including MSA and method validation 

Plan and implement new methods, equipment and lab capabilities 
Manage product and process deviations, NCM’s and escalations towards stakeholders 

Define follow up and report lab KPI’s  

Manage improvements, the implementation and maintain 5S in the Cell Analysis lab 

Represent the lab in internal, customer and supplier audits 

Plan and follow up the lab budget and investments 

Attest time reports on time and ensure to comply with local and companywide processes 

 

Accountability/Authorization 

Budget responsibility: Yes 

Direct reports: Yes 

Work Environment responsibility: Yes 

Authorized to decide on investments according to role and policy 

 

Requirements 

Educational background and previous experience required for the role 

BS or MSc in Mechanical Engineering, Material Science, Natural Science or Engineering 

10+ years of relevant work experience in quality assurance, metrology or laboratory testing in automotive, medical or battery industry 

 

Qualifications and Experience 

Proven experience in leadership of international team 
Proven experience in set-up and leadership of quality control laboratories 

Experience in battery cell quality control is a plus 

Knowledge of quality management systems, e.g. ISO 9001, IATF16949, VDA 6.5, ISO/IEC 17025 

Knowledge of automotive core tools (APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA) 

Knowledgeable in Lean and six sigma 

 

Specific skills & Knowledge 

Excellent oral and written communication skills in English, Swedish is a plus 

User experience with Office, JIRA, LIMS, ERP (D365) and Q-DAS or similar software 

Project management 

Budget and asset management 

Hands-on leadership 

 

Personal success factors 

Organized and result driven 

High ability to keep good laboratory practice including 5S, cleanliness, routines, etc 

Solution oriented mindset – exceptionally good problem-solving skills and flexibility 

Drive for quality and an eye for detail 

Ability to work in a high profile and often high-pressured international environment 

Passionate & purpose driven

HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.
What you’ll do 
Would you like to influence the financial success of innovative technology? As Business Controller, you’ll work at the intersection of finance, R&D and product development, helping turn ideas and investments into profitable products.
You will be a financial business partner to R&D and Product Offering, supporting the teams in making informed financial and business decisions. You will provide insight into development costs, investments and product profitability, helping the business understand the financial impact of decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include:
Coordinate budgets and forecasts for R&D and Product Offering, analyzing spending and variances.
Follow development projects and investments, including business cases, and financial outcomes after product launch.
Analyze product profitability, standard costs and cost variances, identifying opportunities for cost improvements.
Maintain pricing data, support annual pricing process and implement approved price changes.
Develop reporting and use digital and AI tools to automate routine work and provide better business insight. 

Based in Halmstad, you will join INT Business Controlling and report to VP Business Controlling. You will be part of an experienced finance team, working closely with colleagues across the business. 
About you 
You are analytical, structured and curious about how the business works. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders and turning financial data into clear insights and decisions. We believe you have: 
Experience in business controlling, financial analysis or a similar role.
A degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong Excel skills and good communication skills in English. 

Experience from a manufacturing environment, as well as familiarity with product or project controlling, cost accounting, Power BI or ERP systems, is an advantage. You do not need experience in every area of the role, we value curiosity, financial judgement and a collaborative approach. 
About us 
At HMS, we put Heart, Mind & Soul into everything we do. These core values not only make for a fitting abbreviation (HMS), but also describe how we work together and create success. We are an innovative growth company headquartered in Halmstad, Sweden, with approximately 1,100 employees in more than 20 countries. Through our global presence, we combine the opportunities of an international organisation with the close-knit and entrepreneurial spirit that has characterised HMS since the beginning. HMS is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels included, respected, and empowered. Visit hms-networks.com and learn more about life at HMS.

Company
Flygprestanda AB has thanks to its leading expertise in the aviation industry for 57 years become one of the leading suppliers of takeoff and landing calculations for airlines worldwide. We are also in the forefront of developing new products and services in the aerospace industry.
We are specialists in software and software related services to the airline's operational departments, where our software services are used by pilots to make takeoff and landing calculations prior to each flight.
 Since our customers use our services prior to each flight, they expect both high quality and flexible solutions.
In fresh premises with an attractive location next to “Stortorget” in central Malmö we can offer a stimulating and challenging position as Manager Software Development
Profile
We are looking for someone with comprehensive technical expertise from the Software Development Lifecycle, preferably back-end oriented, to enter the position as Manager for our Software Project Department. We believe that you are a dedicated problem solving individual, with a team-effort mind-set and a professional personality. You are thorough in your work and believe in organizing your day in a productive manner. You are also expected to have good skills in planning, project management and documentation.
Work description
This position reports to the Managing Director and is also member of the Management group.
The area of responsibility includes planning of software development activities and team management. Working on and planning multiple projects is also part of the daily tasks and includes liaising with team members of different departments, such as Engineers, other Software Developers and Sales & Marketing Manager.
The product portfolio consist of a variety of aircraft performance and flight planning related services and applications, aimed for pilots and dispatch centers.
The Software Development team
We are a small but dedicated team consisting of: Software Developers, Tester,Graphic Designer. A solution oriented mindset is a valuable asset in our daily work.
You will be resonsible for (amongst responsibilities)
- Responsible for hiring of personnel within the department.
- Strategic service/product planning together with Management.
- Plan and follow up on the software development Lifecycle overall.
- Plan and follow up on the daily software development process (scrum).
- Provide technical in-house expertise related to the software solutions developed.
- Handle Software Development statistics.
- Documentation
Required skills
- Fluent in English on a professional level. Also in writing.
- Knowledge in project management.
Favorable experience
- Knowledge in aircraft performance and flight planning
- Degree in Software Development.
- Experience of Java, Javascript or other relevant programming languages.
- Good knowledge in the Swedish language.
Application
Send your CV and a personal letter to careers@flygp.se, not later than 17/12-2026.
Note: This position may be appointed prior to above stated deadline.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Verification & Test Engineer to support the development of advanced process equipment within a technology-driven R&D organization operating in a highly regulated industry.
The assignment focuses on verification and testing of components, modules, and complete systems to ensure performance, robustness, and quality throughout the product development lifecycle.
You will work closely with design engineers, project teams, and system specialists, combining hands-on laboratory testing with data analysis, technical documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
What You Will Work On
Plan, execute, and document verification activities for components, modules, and complete systems.
Perform functional, endurance, robustness, and destructive testing.
Test mechanical, electromechanical, and fluid-handling components such as valves, pumps, sensors, and assemblies.
Conduct environmental testing under controlled temperature and humidity conditions using climate chambers.
Perform ingress protection (IP) testing and evaluate sealing performance and product integrity.
Build, modify, and improve test fixtures, test rigs, and laboratory setups.
Collect, analyse, and evaluate test data to support engineering and design decisions.
Develop and maintain test methods, procedures, and verification documentation.
Prepare technical reports and communicate test results to project stakeholders.
Collaborate with engineering teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

What You Bring
Technical degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Biomedical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Engineering Physics, or a related field.
Experience in verification, validation, testing, or laboratory activities within product development.
Experience planning and executing structured test activities according to requirements and protocols.
Strong understanding of test methods, laboratory equipment, test rigs, and measurement systems.
Ability to analyse test data and present technical conclusions clearly.
Experience preparing technical documentation and test reports.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering functions.
Fluent Swedish and English, written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience testing valves, pumps, sensors, fluid systems, or process equipment.
Experience with environmental testing and climate chamber operation.
Knowledge of ingress protection (IP) testing and sealing verification.
Experience in regulated industries such as MedTech, Life Science, Pharma, Diagnostics, or Industrial Equipment.
Familiarity with Design Verification (DV) and Verification & Validation (V&V) methodologies.
Experience developing automated test methods.
Programming and scripting experience using Python or AI-assisted tools.
Experience with data analysis and visualization.
Experience building or modifying test fixtures and laboratory equipment.
Familiarity with Lean, 5S, and continuous improvement methodologies.

The Cloud Platform organization develops and maintains cloud services globally to contribute to the overall connected experience for customers. We build, provide and operate a highly secure run-time ecosystem for functions and applications serving our connected cars, and their users. We aim to optimize functional and organic growth by using standard cloud technologies with high level of synergies and re-use. With car cloud solution, we provide cloud infrastructure, platform core & services to support software development lifecycle (DevOps) by providing tools for fast feedback & built-in quality.
What you´ll do
The mission is to create a great developer experience by providing platform products that support high performance & productivity. You will collaborate with your Product Owner to ensure the right functionality is being developed and estimate the size and complexity of the work to be able to plan upcoming sprints. You will determine and maintain the technical design in our area within the given architectural guidelines.
Tech we use daily:
SW Languages: Java (Spring-boot)
Frameworks: Spring, Istio
IDP: Azure AD, AWS IAM
Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Docker
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Oracle
IaC: Terraform, Crossplane
Message broker: Kafka, JMS
Protocols: MQTT, gRPC, REST HTTP
Tools: GitLab, ArgoCD, Github
Test automation: JUnit 5 , Testcontainers
Monitoring: Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, PagerDuty
Architecture: Micro Service Architecture
Development methodology principles: Scrum, Kanban, GitOps
Automation: python, bash
Do you fit the profile?
We believe you have at least 5 years of experience with Java development. You probably have a BSc degree or higher in computer science or equivalent.
In order to thrive in the team, you should not be afraid to work also with the Infrastructure side of Cloud Development, including configuration.
Previous experience in handling car-related information to the cloud, to cars, to mobile apps and to partners, is highly valued. You have experience with AWS, Java, Kafka, Python and Kubernetes.
We also think you have understanding in agile development methodology principles (e.g., Scrum, Lean, Kanban) and have worked in product teams. We see that you are fluent in the English language.
For you to fully enjoy this opportunity, we believe that you have a genuine interest of working and developing in a product area. You embrace teamwork, collaboration and are eager to learn and develop new competences. We also expect you to be on top of technology evolution within software development and provide new ideas to continuously improve the product and our processes.
As a person you are communicative and can easily collaborate. You are supportive to your team and open and flexible. Curious, with a can-do attitude. 
Additional info:
We schedule interviews on a rolling basis so do not wait until end date.

jobs.occupation: Factory R&D  Structural analysis and simulation specialist
jobs.description:
The opportunity
With continuous and sustainable growth of our business we take the opportunity to strengthen our expertise and capacity with a new position with focus on structural analysis and numerical simulations Main focus will be on mechanical stress analysis, but also fluid mechanics simulations and dielectric simulations will be within the scope on a project basis.
You will be part of Hitachi Energy’s competence center for fiber-reinforced polymer composites and silicone elastomers in Piteå. We are a team with world-class expertise and experience in realization, verification, and production of polymer composite products. The main products are structural and electrically insulating components used in high voltage transformers and switchgear which are vital for the transition to fossil free energy. Our customers are all over the world, both inside and outside Hitachi.
How you’ll make an impact
·         Stress analysis and sizing of composite structures subject to mechanical and thermal loads to support new product development and order design.
·         Simulation of our manufacturing processes (e.g. wet filament winding, oven cure, silicone extrusion) to develop process expertise further and support process optimization and increased robustness.
·         Lead projects and activities related to development of design tools and design criteria.
·         Documentation of designs and review of test results to improve design criteria.
·         Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. design, quality, SCM, production) to solve complex engineering challenges and deliver robust solutions, both within our local/global organization and in cooperation with customers, suppliers, and academia.
·         Apply robust analytical and critical thinking to solve complex challenges and to perform comprehensive risk reviews.
Your background
·         University engineering degree in composites engineering, applied mechanics, applied physics or similar.
·         Expertise in Finite Element Analysis including experience with composite structures with layered anisotropic materials.
·         Ability to cooperate and communicate both with experts at an academic level, as well as colleagues and project members with expertise in other areas
·         Genuine interest and curiosity about technology.
·         Ability and willingness to acquire new knowledge and skills.
·         Team player who finds it easy to cooperate with others.
·         Good communication skills in both spoken and written English and a basic understanding of Swedish are mandatory requirements. 
More about us
Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Welcome to apply! Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today! 
Recruiting Manager Anders Holmberg, anders.holmberg@hitachienergy.com, will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Marcus Nordlund-Oja, +46 107-38 31 93; Unionen: Per Lidman, +46 73 0500 603; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 70 43. All other questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Filip Henriksson, filip.henriksson@hitachienergy.com

Intermodulation Products AB is a pioneering company developing advanced test and measurement equipment for the quantum technology sector. As we continue to expand the reach of our flagship Presto platform, we are looking for a highly technical and outgoing Quantum Application Engineer to join our team in Stockholm.
In this role, you will be the crucial link between our technology and the global physics community. Your primary focus will be helping existing and potential customers understand how Presto can solve their most complex measurement needs across superconducting circuits, quantum sensing, computing, and communication. You will own and run live demonstrations using our in-house superconducting qubit setup, represent us at scientific conferences, and provide critical technical support for both sales and existing users. You will also travel to customer laboratories, spending time with researchers to deeply understand their experimental workflows and pain points, and bring those insights directly back to our development team. This role is perfect for a physicist who loves being hands-on with technology but finds it equally fun and energizing to interact with people.
Responsibilities
Help existing and potential customers understand how the Presto platform solves specific measurement challenges in quantum tech and RF.
Own, maintain, and present live technical demonstrations using our superconducting qubit setup.
Represent the company at international scientific conferences, presenting our products at the booth and engaging with fellow physicists.
Partner with the sales team to provide technical pre-sales support and system configuration advice.
Assist customers with high-level technical support questions and troubleshooting.
Travel to customer labs to spend time on-site, understanding their measurement pain points and workflows.
Act as the voice of the customer, forwarding field knowledge and feature requests to our internal development team.

Requirements
PhD (preferred) or MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Quantum Engineering, or a highly related field.
Strong background in experimental physics with hands-on knowledge of microwave and low-temperature measurements.
A highly technical mindset coupled with a strong willingness and enthusiasm to engage, network, and interact with fellow physicists.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex measurement concepts clearly.
Willingness and ability to travel to scientific conferences and customer laboratories globally.
Good written and spoken English.

Meritorious Qualifications: You do not need to have experience in all of the areas below. Experience in one or more is considered an advantage:
Experience with Python programming, specifically for data acquisition, instrument control, and data analysis.
Previous experience in technical sales, field application engineering, or customer-facing scientific support.
Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting dilution refrigerators or other cryogenic systems.
Practical experience working directly with superconducting qubits or similar solid-state quantum devices.
Familiarity with RF/microwave instrumentation (e.g., AWGs, VNAs, digitizers, spectrum analyzers).
Experience with experimental control software and quantum measurement frameworks (e.g., QCoDeS, Labber, Qiskit Experiments).
Basic understanding of FPGA-based signal processing.

About us
Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have a wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
We’re looking for a Junior Project Manager to join our OpenRGS team, supporting external partner studios as they bring their games to market through Hacksaw’s technology, tools, and platforms. You’ll help coordinate projects, keep communication flowing between partners and internal teams, and follow up on progress to keep deliveries on track. This is an opportunity to build your project management skills while gaining hands-on experience in the gaming industry.

The Role
Your key responsibilities include:
Managing and coordinating game integration projects together with external partner studios.
Acting as a main point of contact for partners regarding timelines, feedback, requirements, and delivery status.
Following up on project activities and helping identify potential blockers early.
Gathering details about reported issues and bugs, working with internal teams to coordinate fixes, and following up on resolutions.
Tracking, organizing, and prioritizing tasks in our ticketing system.
Learning how regulatory requirements apply to our games and helping check that these are met, with full training provided.
Staying up to date with industry trends and player preferences.
Taking part in development reviews to track progress and share feedback.
Producing documentation and reference materials for clients as needed.

﻿What We’re Looking For:
You’re at the start of your career, whether you’re a recent graduate or have some initial experience in project coordination or a similar role.
You enjoy organizing tasks, keeping track of details, and following up to help things move forward.
You take initiative, ask questions, and are eager to learn and grow within project management.
You enjoy working with people from different disciplines and building strong working relationships.
You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and in conversation.

Nice-to-have:
Studies in project management, game production, business, or a related field.
Experience coordinating a project through your studies, an internship, work, or extracurricular activities.
Familiarity with project management tools.
An interest in games or iGaming.

What We Offer
A modern office in central Stockholm.
Work with experienced, passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
The opportunity to create games with a global audience.
Real influence, ownership, and personal growth opportunities.
Wellbeing perks including wellness allowance and regular in-office massage.

Practical Details
This is an on-site position in Stockholm.
Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.

Together as a Team

Apply now!

Ingka co-workers will be prioritized in this recruitment process.

jobs.occupation: Scrum Master - Automotive product development-20758 - Södertälje
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Scrum Master for a new development project focused on automotive interior and seat development. The role is responsible for leading and supporting a cross-functional development team, maintaining alignment with project objectives, and driving planning, execution, and delivery in accordance with agile principles.
